title: UAAP: Ateneo ends Season 89 campaign with win over UE

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines—Ateneo may be out of the UAAP Season 89 Final Four race, but the Blue Eagles made sure to end their tournament on a winning note, beating University of the East, 86-81, on Wednesday at Mall of Asia Arena. Ateneo wrapped up its campaign with a 6-8 record as it couldn’t sustain its strong 3-1 start to the season. “I think we did good; there were some lapses, but a win is a win, it’s a good send-off to our graduating players as well,” prized rookie Kieffer Alas said.
